visuals.heading: Every Engineering Campus in India Runs

items.text: A flat list of twelve job titles is not useful by itself.
Take away the words "software engineer" and look at what four years of engineering actually built.
You built structured problem-solving, comfort with technical detail, the ability to read a spec or a drawing, and enough numeric fluency to hold your own in a room full of non-technical people.
That exact skill set is the raw material for GATE and PSU exams, UPSC ESE papers, MBA case interviews, product decisions, analytics work, consulting client problems, and patent drafting.

blocks.heading: Three Routes People Forget to List

items.text: Beyond the twelve paths above, three more routes genuinely use an engineering degree and deserve a place on your shortlist before you settle on software or GATE-PSU by default.
TES, SSC Tech, and Naval/Air Force technical branches
It suits people who want structure, national service, and hands-on technical leadership over a desk-only career, and it does not require the UPSC ESE branch restriction.

blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick One Path

items.text: Twelve paths is still too many to hold in your head at once.
Do you want a desk job with steady hours, a field or site-heavy role, an exam-heavy multi-year grind, or a fast-changing client-facing pace.
A path with a great salary story that fights your natural work style will not survive five years.

visuals.heading: GATE and PSU Jobs

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Over 70 PSUs, including NTPC, ONGC, BHEL, IOCL, GAIL, PowerGrid, and HPCL, recruit engineers directly through GATE scores instead of running a separate entrance exam. Entry-level CTC typically runs Rs 12-20 LPA once allowances are included, with GATE score cutoffs for PSU shortlisting usually landing in the 650-850+ range depending on branch and PSU.

blocks.heading: Everyone Wants and Almost Nobody Enters Directly

figures.label: Estimated Time Required
figures.source: Most product managers in India spent 2-4 years first as a software engineer, business analyst, or in a customer-facing technical role, then moved sideways once they had proof of user and business judgment.
figures.text: Most product managers in India spent 2-4 years first as a software engineer, business analyst, or in a customer-facing technical role, then moved sideways once they had proof of user and business judgment.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Reported product manager compensation in India averages around Rs 41 lakhs, with a wide range from roughly Rs 23 lakhs to well over a crore at senior levels. These figures describe people well into their career, not fresher entry pay. Product managers usually earn more than software engineers at the same seniority because they carry a broader, higher-accountability scope, not because the entry bar is lower.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Fresher pay typically starts around Rs 4-8 LPA, moving to roughly Rs 8-14 LPA by the two-to-three-year mark for people who add Python, SQL, and visualisation depth on top of the base role. A Business Analyst role leans more toward interpreting data for a business decision, while a Data Scientist role leans more toward building the underlying predictive model, a useful distinction when you are choosing which of the two to target first.

blocks.heading: Headline Salary Is Usually the MBA-Entry Number

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Big 4 entry-level roles for non-MBA freshers commonly start in the Rs 6-10 LPA range, sometimes higher at select campuses, while the widely quoted Rs 13-24 LPA figures usually describe Tier-1 MBA hiring or highly selective campus tracks, not the general fresher-without-MBA path. MBB firms (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) sit at the very top of the pay ladder but recruit an even narrower slice of candidates, almost always with a strong MBA or equivalent pedigree.

blocks.heading: Tell Your Parents or a Placement-Panicked Mind

items.text: "Not software" sounds like walking away from the one clearly understood, safe outcome.
They have not heard the real numbers on GATE-PSU pay, UPSC ESE structure, or patent agent income.
They worry the backup plan is vague, not concrete.
